anchor.statement: Theorem 4.6. There exist fixed h ∈ (0, 1/100), λ > 0, C > 1, and 0 < X a < X b , together with profiles E, U, Π for X ≥ 0, −1 ≤ η ≤ 1, having the following properties. The quantities F, H, V 0 , Q s , N s , p s , a, b s and T 0 are defined by Equations (4.7) to (4.11); where a > 0, t s , v s are defined in (4.20). We use A, d from (4.1). The closed annulus below means the profile rectangle [X a , X b ] × [−1, 1] in (X, η ). All assertions hold for every η ∈ [−1, 1].
